2609.28449.title: Can LLMs Reason About Runtime Behavior? A Repository-Level Dynamic Benchmark
2609.28449.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in coding tasks, but their ability to reason about code execution remains unclear. Existing repository-level QA benchmarks mainly evaluate static code understanding and often rely on LLM-based evaluation, while execution-reasoning benchmarks are mostly limited to snippets or functions. We introduce SWE-Flux, a repository-level benchmark for dynamic execution reasoning containing 480 execution-grounded instances across 12 real Python repositories, with gold answers automatically harvested from instrumented test executions rather than written manually or judged by LLMs. The benchmark covers singletest and multi-test questions over control flow, loops, program state, dataflow, exceptions, and program invariants. Evaluating five LLMs shows that this task remains challenging. The best model achieves only 37% accuracy. Models perform better on localized behavior such as invariants, intra-procedural control flow, exceptions, and simple loops, but struggle with dataflow, inter-procedural execution, precise state reasoning, and suite-level aggregation. Finally, we show that the oracle-harvesting pipeline can generate fresh benchmark variants using input perturbation. It successfully harvests valid variants for almost 90% of the selected instances, and the resulting variants are substantially more challenging for the evaluated models.
2609.28449.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在編碼任務中的使用越來越普遍，但它們對於程式執行的推理能力仍然不清楚。現有的庫級質量保證基準主要評估靜態程式碼理解，並且通常依賴於基於LLM的評估，而執行推理基準大多僅限於片段或函數。我們介紹了SWE-Flux，這是一個針對動態執行推理的庫級基準，包含來自12個真實Python庫的480個執行基礎實例，金標答案是自動從儀器化測試執行中收集的，而不是手動編寫或由LLM評判的。該基準涵蓋了控制流、循環、程式狀態、數據流、異常和程式不變式的單測試和多測試問題。對五個LLM的評估顯示，這項任務仍然具有挑戰性。最佳模型的準確率僅為37%。模型在局部行為上表現更好，例如不變式、程序內控制流、異常和簡單循環，但在數據流、程序間執行、精確狀態推理和套件級聚合方面則面臨困難。最後，我們展示了oracle收集管道可以利用輸入擾動生成新的基準變體。它成功地為幾乎90%的選定實例收集了有效變體，而生成的變體對於被評估的模型來說具有實質上更大的挑戰。
